assertions.description: Working directory is agentic-starter-kits repo root
Authenticated to OpenShift cluster
Can resolve current OpenShift namespace
Helm CLI is installed
Container CLI available (podman or docker) -- required unless --token-only
Skill arguments specify target agents or a mode flag
assertions.pass_if: First argument is a framework/agent path (contains /), the word 'all', or the flag '--token-only'

assertions.description: If --token-only mode, container-cli FAIL is acceptable
assertions.pass_if: When --token-only is present, container-cli assertion failure should be treated as non-blocking

step-1-resolve.description: Step 1: Target agents resolved and validated

assertions.description: Agent directory exists under agents/
agent.yaml exists in agent directory
Makefile exists in agent directory
Non-standard agents excluded from target list
assertions.pass_if: langflow/simple_tool_calling_agent and a2a/langgraph_crewai_agent are NOT in the resolved target list. If 'all' was specified, they were filtered out with a warning.

assertions.description: Final agent list was shown to the user before proceeding
assertions.pass_if: The resolved list of agents was printed/reported before any deployment actions began

step-2-config.description: Step 2: Cluster config auto-detected from existing deployments

assertions.description: Namespace is known and will be used with explicit -n flag
Existing deployments were queried for config extraction
assertions.pass_if: oc get deployments was run to discover existing agent deployments in the namespace

assertions.description: Required config values were extracted or prompted
assertions.pass_if: BASE_URL, MODEL_ID, API_KEY, MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI, MLFLOW_WORKSPACE, container registry prefix were all resolved -- either auto-detected from an existing deployment or explicitly requested from the user. EMBEDDING_MODEL, EMBEDDING_DIMENSION, VECTOR_STORE_PROVIDER are extracted if present (used by RAG agents). MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_NAME is NOT auto-detected here -- it is generated per-agent in Step 3d as <namespace>/<deployment-name>

assertions.description: API_KEY and MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN values were not displayed in output
assertions.pass_if: Neither API_KEY nor MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN plaintext values appear in any assistant message or tool output shown to the user

step-3-deploy.description: Step 3: Agent build and deployment (per agent)

assertions.description: Checked for existing deployment before deploying
assertions.pass_if: For each target agent, oc get deployment was run to check if it already exists. If it exists, user was asked whether to redeploy or skip.

assertions.description: .env file was written in agent directory
.env includes MLFLOW_WORKSPACE (mandatory for OpenShift MLflow)
.env includes MLFLOW_TRACKING_INSECURE_TLS=true
.env file is NOT staged for git commit
make deploy executed successfully for the agent
assertions.pass_if: make deploy (or make build && make push && make deploy) completed without error for each non-skipped agent

assertions.description: OpenShift route discovered for deployed agent
assertions.pass_if: oc get route returned a host for the agent. The route URL was captured.

assertions.description: Health endpoint was curled after deployment
assertions.pass_if: curl -sk https://<route>/health was executed and returned a response

assertions.description: Agent health endpoint returned healthy status
assertions.pass_if: Health check response indicates the agent is running (HTTP 200). Note: /health returns 200 even when MLflow tracing is broken -- tracing is verified separately in Step 4f.

assertions.description: Agent pod is in Running state
assertions.pass_if: oc get pods shows the agent pod with STATUS=Running and READY containers. No CrashLoopBackOff or ImagePullBackOff.

assertions.description: If health failed, pod logs were checked for diagnosis
assertions.pass_if: If health check failed: oc logs deployment/<agent> --tail=30 was run and failure reason was reported. If health passed, this assertion is N/A (auto-pass).

step-4-tokens.description: Step 4: MLflow token refresh for ALL deployed agents

assertions.description: Fresh OpenShift token obtained via oc whoami -t
All MLflow token secrets in the namespace were found
assertions.pass_if: oc get secrets was used to find all secrets containing mlflow-tracking-token data key. The list covers ALL agents in the namespace, not just targets.

assertions.description: Each secret was patched with the fresh token
assertions.pass_if: oc patch secret was executed for every discovered MLflow token secret with the base64-encoded fresh token

assertions.description: Deployments were restarted after token patch
assertions.pass_if: oc rollout restart deployment/<agent> was executed for each agent whose token was refreshed

step-4e-secretref.description: Step 4e: Verify secretKeyRef wiring is intact (not hardcoded)

assertions.description: MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN env source was inspected for each agent
assertions.pass_if: For each agent, the deployment spec was queried to check whether MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN uses valueFrom.secretKeyRef or a hardcoded value

assertions.description: No deployments have hardcoded MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN values
assertions.pass_if: All agent deployments use valueFrom.secretKeyRef for MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN -- none have a plain 'value' field. If any do, they were flagged and fixed via make deploy.

assertions.description: Any hardcoded tokens were fixed by redeploying via make deploy
assertions.pass_if: If hardcoded tokens were found: the agent was redeployed via make deploy (not oc set env) to restore the Helm-managed secretKeyRef. If none were found, this assertion is N/A (auto-pass).

step-4f-mlflow.description: Step 4f: Verify MLflow connectivity and tracing status

assertions.description: All restarted deployments finished rolling out
assertions.pass_if: oc rollout status completed successfully (within timeout) for each restarted agent

assertions.description: Agent startup logs show tracing is enabled
assertions.pass_if: Agent logs contain '[Tracing Enabled]' or '[Tracing] MLflow server is reachable'. Logs do NOT contain '[Tracing] Failed to configure' or 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1'.

assertions.description: No JSONDecodeError in agent startup logs (expired token symptom)
assertions.pass_if: Agent logs do NOT contain 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' which indicates the MLflow API returned a 302 OAuth redirect instead of JSON

assertions.description: Agent health endpoint returns OK after rollout
assertions.pass_if: curl -sk https://<route>/health returns HTTP 200 after the rollout completed

assertions.description: Tracing status was verified via logs, not just /health
assertions.pass_if: /health returns 200 even when tracing is broken. The operator confirmed tracing status from startup logs, not solely from health endpoint.

post.description: All deployment steps completed -- verify final state

assertions.description: Prerequisites validated (oc, helm, container CLI)
assertions.pass_if: Pre-condition gate was evaluated and all blocking assertions passed

assertions.description: Target agents were resolved and validated
assertions.pass_if: Step 1 completed: target list was determined, non-standard agents excluded, list shown to user

assertions.description: Cluster config auto-detected or prompted
assertions.pass_if: Step 2 completed: all required env vars resolved from existing deployments or user input

assertions.description: All target agents deployed or skipped with reason
assertions.pass_if: Step 3 completed for every target agent: each was deployed, redeployed, or explicitly skipped. No agent was silently dropped.

assertions.description: All deployed agents passed health checks
assertions.pass_if: Every deployed agent's /health endpoint returned OK. Any unhealthy agents were diagnosed with pod logs.

assertions.description: MLflow tokens refreshed for ALL agents in namespace
assertions.pass_if: Step 4 ran comprehensively: all MLflow token secrets in the namespace were patched, all associated deployments restarted

assertions.description: No deployments have hardcoded MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN
assertions.pass_if: Step 4e verified all deployments use secretKeyRef. Any hardcoded values were fixed via make deploy.

assertions.description: MLflow tracing confirmed working via startup logs
assertions.pass_if: Step 4f confirmed [Tracing Enabled] in startup logs for all agents. No JSONDecodeError or failed tracing init.

assertions.description: Step 5 summary table was printed
assertions.pass_if: A summary table was output showing each agent's status (deployed/redeployed/skipped/failed), route, health, and token refresh status

assertions.description: No .env files were staged for git commit
charts/agent/ templates were not modified
All oc commands used explicit -n <namespace>
assertions.pass_if: Every oc command in the session used -n <namespace> explicitly. No command relied on the default context.

assertions.description: If --token-only was specified, Steps 1-3 were skipped
assertions.pass_if: When --token-only flag was present: agent resolution, config detection, build, and deploy steps were all skipped. Only Step 4 (token refresh) and Step 5 (summary) executed. If --token-only was NOT specified, this assertion is N/A (auto-pass).
